implementation_contract.atomicity: Serialize to a unique sibling temporary file, flush and fsync it, replace with os.replace, and remove temporary residue on every failure. A module-level path-keyed shared reentrant lock prevents lost updates across TelegramInboxStore instances in this process; no cross-process serialization guarantee is claimed.
implementation_contract.bounds_and_rotation: Each generation is bounded independently by both record count and its compact serialized UTF-8 byte size. The envelope contains at most two generations and fixed schema overhead. When adding a valid receipt would exceed either current-generation bound, atomically replace previous with the old current and start current with the new receipt. If the single new entry cannot fit, leave the existing audit file unchanged.

configuration.TELEGRAM_AUDIT_MAX_BYTES: default 131072 serialized UTF-8 bytes per generation; integer range 4096..1048576
configuration.invalid_rule: unset or empty uses the default; a non-integer, non-positive or out-of-range explicit value makes the audit store unavailable for that call, so reads return empty and writes leave every file unchanged

implementation_contract.fail_closed: Missing audit file may be initialized by a valid append. Corrupt JSON, schema-invalid envelopes, invalid entries, read I/O errors and write/replace errors make the audit store unavailable: read empty, write no-op, and never repair, truncate, delete or overwrite the suspect file.
implementation_contract.privacy: Only receipts freshly produced by project_telegram_audit_record with its exact closed field set and value types may be persisted. scope_ref must be empty or the existing chat_<12 lowercase hex> handle and is never returned by audit_history. Text, caption, prompt, reply, transcript, exception, path, filename, token, raw identifiers and arbitrary mappings are forbidden.
implementation_contract.read_rule: audit_history reads only the new audit store, filters internally by the existing hashed chat scope when requested, returns only receipt objects in newest-first order, and never falls back to telegram_history.json.
implementation_contract.retention: Reads suppress receipts older than the configured day window without mutation. Successful appends prune expired receipts from the audit envelope only before enforcing bounds and rotation, and reject an already expired new receipt before mutation. A zero, future-invalid or otherwise invalid recorded_at receipt is rejected without changing audit or legacy files. Status updates use their newly written updated_at as audit recorded_at rather than the original message stored_at.
implementation_contract.runtime_file: telegram_audit_receipts.json under the configured Telegram plugin data directory
implementation_contract.schema: one atomic envelope containing current and previous generations; each stored entry contains only one internal hashed scope_ref and one exact odysseus.telegram.audit_receipt.v1 projection
implementation_contract.source_rule: Every newly successful append_event, append_inbound, append_outbound and update_inbound_status legacy write best-effort projects that just-written record through project_telegram_audit_record and appends it to the separate audit store. Existing records are never backfilled.
